prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1051; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through an intersection in Houston, Texas, and was struck while making a left turn by a vehicle operated by Driver 2. Upon arrival, I observed both vehicles in the roadway and spoke with the drivers at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and said the impact jolted the body forward and against the seatbelt. The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of a collision of this kind. Damage to the front driver side of Driver 1's vehicle matches the impact described by both parties, and I found no indication of earlier damage to that area. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general positions of the vehicles and the visible damage, though no independent witnesses came forward. Police records and statements from both drivers confirm that a Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the crash. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review of the collision.
